title: Typewriter and Regiment
author: Noor Thornbury
blurb: Jude Marchetti, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
